descriptions.zh:
注意： 
- **endpoint**和其他接口有区别，国内和新加坡需使用**polardbx.aliyuncs.com**， 其他地域使用**polardbx.{region id}.aliyunc.com**。
- 调试此API接口的时候，如果报服务不可用的错，请确认下**endpoint**是否正确，可通过切换**服务地址**到**迪拜**或者**印度**，将**endpoint**切换到**polardbx.aliyuncs.com**。
descriptions.en:
Note: 
- The **endpoint** differs from other operations. Use **polardbx.aliyuncs.com** for Chinese mainland regions and Singapore. For other regions, use **polardbx.{region id}.aliyunc.com**.
- When testing this API operation, if a service unavailable error is returned, verify that the **endpoint** is correct. You can switch the **service address** to **Dubai** or **India** to change the **endpoint** to **polardbx.aliyuncs.com**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardbx change-resource-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type polardbxinstance --resource-id pxc-szrwrbp6930000 --new-resource-group-id rg-acfmwolx3j40000 --region cn-hangzhou
